testcase.name: Scenario: Retain separate zoom levels in two windows of a part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:414:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain separate zoom levels in two windows of a part ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the user creates a second window for the part through View New ✔ And the first window displays an active sketch ✔ And the second window is active ✔ When the user scrolls to zoom in within the second window ✔ Then its displayed geometry appears enlarged ✔ When the user selects the first window from the View tab's Switch menu ✔ Then the first window retains its previous sketch view and scale ✔ When the user returns to the second window ✔ Then the second window retains its zoomed-in view
